name: Away.span_mk_prod_pow_eq_top
statement: A} {d : ι} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) {ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι'] (v : ι' → A) (hx : Algebra.adjoin (𝒜 0) (Set.range v) = ⊤) (dv : ι' → ι) (hxd : ∀ i, v i ∈ 𝒜 (dv i)) : Submodule.span (𝒜 0) { (Away.mk 𝒜 hf a (∏ i, v i ^ ai i) (hai ▸ SetLike.prod_pow_mem_graded _ _ _ _ fun i _ ↦ hxd i) : Away 𝒜 f) | (a : ℕ) (ai : ι' → ℕ) (hai : ∑ i, ai i • dv i = a • d) } = ⊤

name: Away.adjoin_mk_prod_pow_eq_top
statement: A} {d : ℕ} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (ι' : Type*) [Fintype ι'] (v : ι' → A) (hx : Algebra.adjoin (𝒜 0) (Set.range v) = ⊤) (dv : ι' → ℕ) (hxd : ∀ i, v i ∈ 𝒜 (dv i)) : Algebra.adjoin (𝒜 0) { Away.mk 𝒜 hf a (∏ i, v i ^ ai i) (hai ▸ SetLike.prod_pow_mem_graded _ _ _ _ fun i _ ↦ hxd i) | (a : ℕ) (ai : ι' → ℕ) (hai : ∑ i, ai i • dv i = a • d) (_ : ∀ i, ai i ≤ d) } = ⊤
